features.name: is_high_fingerprinting
features.description: Boolean indicator if the domain or any of its resources have a fingerprinting score of 2 or higher.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct split for tree models to isolate domains with aggressive fingerprinting behavior.

features.name: cookie_retention_days_clipped
features.description: Maximum cookie TTL in days, clipped to 365 days to handle extreme outliers and focus on practical retention periods.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme outliers in cookie expiration dates, allowing tree models to split more effectively on typical retention periods.

features.name: script_to_resource_ratio
features.description: Ratio of script resources to total resources, indicating how script-heavy the domain's footprint is.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the composition of resources, helping models identify domains that primarily serve executable code rather than static assets.

features.name: api_diversity_score
features.description: Log-scaled product of distinct API count and mean API weight, representing the breadth and depth of API usage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a nonlinear interaction feature that highlights domains using many different, heavily-weighted APIs.

features.name: has_suspicious_api_combo
features.description: Boolean indicator if the domain uses a combination of canvas, navigator, and screen APIs, often associated with device identification.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a strong categorical grouping for tree models based on known combinations of APIs used for device profiling.

features.name: domain_prevalence_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket categorizing the prevalence of the domain across the web.
features.expected_model_benefit: Discretizes a highly skewed continuous variable into ordinal buckets, which tree models can split on more robustly.

features.name: cookie_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled sum of total cookies sent and total first-party cookies, measuring the overall cookie footprint.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines multiple cookie metrics into a single, well-distributed feature that captures the intensity of stateful tracking.

features.name: owner_privacy_transparency
features.description: Boolean indicator if the domain has both an identified owner and a privacy policy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups domains by their level of transparency and accountability, providing a clear categorical split.

features.name: subdomain_sprawl
features.description: Log-scaled count of subdomains, indicating the complexity of the domain's infrastructure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes a skewed count variable, helping models identify domains that use extensive subdomain generation.

features.name: weighted_fp_per_site
features.description: Ratio of weighted fingerprinting score to the number of sites the domain appears on.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes fingerprinting activity by the domain's reach, highlighting domains that are highly aggressive relative to their footprint.

features.name: semantic_behavior_profile
features.description: Judgment feature assessing the overall behavior profile based on API usage patterns, cookie behavior, and fingerprinting scores.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex, non-formulaic semantic relationships between different types of web activities.

features.name: stealth_behavior_score
features.description: Judgment feature evaluating the likelihood of stealthy behavior, such as high API usage combined with low prevalence or CNAME cloaking.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic assessment of evasive techniques that are difficult to capture with simple mathematical formulas.
